subject: MAP: Private GPU pool acceptance & lead-time icebox
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Bennett <emily.bennett@aureliatx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: private GPU pool sizing + lead-time items

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is an initial mutual action plan (MAP) focused on Private deployment acceptance and capacity reservation so we can align timelines and gating. High level asks from our side:

- Confirm target qps/peak tokens per second so we can size the dedicated H100 tranche.
- Decide on acceptance gating (latency SLOs, perf smoke tests, SOC2 artifacts).
- Procurement window: confirm PO target date so we can align procurement lead-time (we're seeing 8–12 week lead times for private racks in the current supply cadence).

I've cc'd Ben (capacity) and Marissa (onboarding) to propose sizing options and an acceptance checklist. Please reply with availability for a handshake call this week (30 min) and any procurement contacts to include.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v1_Aurelia.pdf (MAP draft, 6 pages)
From: Emily Bennett <emily.bennett@aureliatx.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Choi <tom.choi@aureliatx.com>, Procurement <procurement@aureliatx.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: private GPU pool sizing + lead-time items

Karthik —

Thanks, got the MAP. A few quick clarifications from our side:

1) Workload: avg inference = 250 rps, peak bursts up to ~1.2k rps with short tails. Typical prompt length 700 tokens; we plan to use a 4k context model for primary flows.
2) Acceptance: engineering will want a smoke test harness + replay of 48h of production traffic (sanitized). Do you have a standard replay format?
3) Procurement: we usually need a 60–90 day window to process POs internally; finance expects final SOW and a procurement-friendly terms doc.

Tom — looping you for procurement cadence and to flag any redlines up front.

Emily Bennett
Head of Product | Aurelia Therapeutics
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Bennett <emily.bennett@aureliatx.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: private GPU pool sizing + lead-time items

Emily —

Thanks for the workload numbers; that helps. Quick sizing note (back-of-envelope):

- For a 4k context model at ~700 tokens average prompt with 1.2k rps bursts, recommended baseline pool: 8 x H100 equivalent (sized for concurrency + headroom).
- If you want a hot-standby for reliability we recommend +2 GPUs for warm failover.
- Typical private deployment lead time (provisioning, rack installs, KMS/Egress config): 8–12 weeks once PO is finalized.

I'll attach a short capacity options table and a sample smoke test manifest we use for replaying sanitized traffic.

Ben Carter
Capacity Planning Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachments: capacity_options_Aurelia.csv (stub), smoke_replay_format.txt (stub)

Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: private GPU pool sizing + lead-time items

Team —

Finance/procurement here. A couple notes on our side:
- Lead time constraints are real; we need final SOW and a confirmed hardware SKU for the order to start internal approval.
- Our standard procurement window is 90 days from SOW to PO issuance unless we mark it expedited.
- Will need SOC2 in-scope evidence for vendor onboarding; a CSV extract of relevant controls is fine.

Karthik — can you provide a procurement-friendly version of the terms and a DocuSign-ready SOW? That will accelerate processing.

Thanks,
Tom Choi
Senior Procurement Manager | Aurelia Therapeutics
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Bennett <emily.bennett@aureliatx.com>, Tom Choi <tom.choi@aureliatx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: private GPU pool sizing + lead-time items

Thanks Tom — understood. Quick proposed next steps (short checklist):

1) Redwood to send procurement-friendly SOW + terms (Karthik / Legal) — target 48 hours.
2) Redwood to deliver updated MAP_v2 with explicit acceptance gating, smoke test manifest, and capacity options (Marissa / Ben) — target 72 hours.
3) Aurelia to confirm PO target date and internal expediting possibility.
4) Engineering handshake call to walk acceptance replay format and data sanitization requirements (Irene to host).

Proposed call window: Thu 07/30 or Fri 07/31, 30 minutes. Does that work for everyone?

Karthik

Subject: MAP_v2 + acceptance checklist and DocuSign SOW

Hi all —

I've attached MAP_v2 which folds in:
- Explicit acceptance gating (latency 95p <= 220ms, throughput tests, smoke replay pass/fail criteria).
- Three capacity options (Baseline = 8 H100, Baseline+HA = 10 H100, Peak-burst = 12 H100).
- Onboarding milestones and handoff: staging verification window (2 weeks), production cutover (1 week).

I also added a procurement-friendly SOW in DocuSign (link below). If you want to shorten the procurement window, we can mark hardware as expedited but that'll change billing cadence.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/abc123-aurelia-map

Attachments: MAP_v2_Aurelia.pdf, procurement-terms-Aurelia.docx

Thanks — ping here with any redlines and we can iterate quickly.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference

Marissa / team —

Looks good, thank you. A few follow-ups before we sign:

- Can your engineering share the smoke_replay_format.txt and a small sample (sanitized) so our infra team can validate the replay tooling?
- We will aim for a PO by 2026-09-15 but need to confirm internally; if procurement accelerates we will move earlier.
- SOC2 extract: please send the CSV you mentioned so our security team can start vendor onboarding.

Karthik — looping Irene for the replay handshake and to coordinate on the acceptance checklist. Irene, can you confirm a 30-minute slot next week to go through replay expectations?

Emily
